# NEW 2026-11-19 Yuan track Y5b (the Yuan princes, oe_yw_). Generated by gen_yuan_y5b.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Debug counter: events sent by this line's scheduler (global var oe_dbg_n_yw).
oe_yw_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_yw } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yw value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yw add = 1 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- interfaces
# Prince scope (interface; y7). Usage: oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = N }. The prince's loyalty (country var oe_yw_loy,
# 0-100) changes by N now and moves back toward its target month by month; the tier follows at once. Does nothing to a
# country this line has not registered.
oe_yw_change_loyalty = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_loy }
        change_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy min = 0 max = 100 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_tier_update = yes }
    }
}
# Any scope (interface; y7). Usage: oe_yw_change_loyalty_all = { amount = N }. The same for every member.
oe_yw_change_loyalty_all = {
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
    c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = $amount$ } } }
}
# CHI scope (interface; the v6.5 panel). Usage: oe_yw_set_grant_level = { level = N }: 0 stopped, 1 as usual, 2 generous
# (double, for one January; back to 1 after it is paid).
oe_yw_set_grant_level = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_level value = $level$ }
}
# CHI scope (interface; y7). Usage: oe_yw_ask_aid = { kind = N }: the Yuan asks its AI princes for help. kind 1 gold: tier
# 2-3 give 20% of their gold (at most 3 grant shares) and lose 3 loyalty, tier 1 give 10% and lose 5, tier 0 give nothing.
# kind 2 manpower: tier 2-3 give 10%, tier 1 give 5% (same loyalty costs). Player princes are not asked.
oe_yw_ask_aid = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_aid_kind value = $kind$ }
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } oe_yw_aid_one = yes } }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yw_aid_kind
}
# Prince scope. One prince's answer to oe_yw_ask_aid.
oe_yw_aid_one = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_tier var:oe_yw_tier >= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_aid_kind = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_tmp value = oe_yw_aid_gold_value }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_tmp > 0 } add_gold = { value = global_var:oe_yw_tmp multiply = -1 } c:CHI ?= { add_gold = global_var:oe_yw_tmp } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_aid_kind = 2 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_tmp value = oe_yw_aid_mp_value }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_tmp > 0 } add_manpower = { value = global_var:oe_yw_tmp multiply = -1 } c:CHI ?= { add_manpower = global_var:oe_yw_tmp } }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_tier >= 2 } oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -3 } }
        else = { oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -5 } }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the princes
# Prince scope. Usage: oe_yw_register = { n = N w = W name = KEY }: joins the line (order N, grant weight W, loyalty
# 55, tier 2) and is called by its title KEY (decision 190; a full title, so the long name shows it alone). Phase 3: the
# Yuan's vassal becomes a 投下宗王 (subject type oe_yw_touxia).
oe_yw_register = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_prince value = $n$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_w value = $w$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy value = 55 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy_target value = 55 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_tier value = 2 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_w > 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } }
    change_country_name = $name$
    set_variable = oe_name_full_title
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_out } remove_variable = oe_yw_out }
    if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia }
    oe_yw_apply_tier = yes
}
# Prince scope. Usage: oe_yw_set_ev = { amount = N months = M }: an event item in the loyalty target (the latest replaces
# an earlier one).
oe_yw_set_ev = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_ev value = $amount$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_ev_until value = oe_yw_m_now }
    change_variable = { name = oe_yw_ev_until add = $months$ }
}
oe_yw_clear_ev = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_ev } remove_variable = oe_yw_ev } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_ev_until } remove_variable = oe_yw_ev_until }
}
# Any scope (v14.5 Princes 2.0, CMDLOG=0). Refreshes CHI's stacking oe_yw_overlord_loyal_host (1..10 stacks by tier-3 loyal princes).
oe_yw_sync_overlord_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_yuan_fallen = no oe_yw_loyal_count >= 1 }
            c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_overlord_loyal_host months = 13 mode = replace size = oe_yw_loyal_count } }
        }
        else = {
            c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_overlord_loyal_host } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_overlord_loyal_host } }
        }
    }
}
# Prince scope. Puts the modifier of the current tier on (13 months), the others off (v14.5: tier 3 loyal, tier 2/1 aloof, tier 0 estranged).
oe_yw_apply_tier = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_tier = 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal months = 13 mode = replace } }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_yw_tier = 2 var:oe_yw_tier = 1 } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof months = 13 mode = replace } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_tier = 0 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged months = 13 mode = replace } }
}
# Prince scope. The tier follows the loyalty; the modifier changes with it. It compares with the script value itself (no
# temporary variable): event options reach this through oe_yw_change_loyalty, and their tooltip preview does not apply
# set_variable (r23 g5: "Invalid right side during comparison 'var:oe_yw_tier_new'").
oe_yw_tier_update = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_tier } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_yw_tier value = oe_yw_tier_value }
        oe_yw_apply_tier = yes
        oe_yw_sync_overlord_host = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_yw_tier = oe_yw_tier_value } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_yw_tier value = oe_yw_tier_value }
        oe_yw_apply_tier = yes
        oe_yw_sync_overlord_host = yes
    }
}
# Prince scope, monthly for a member. Loyalty moves 1 point toward its target and stops there.
oe_yw_loy_step = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy_target value = oe_yw_loy_target_value }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_yw_loy < var:oe_yw_loy_target }
        change_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_loy > var:oe_yw_loy_target } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy value = var:oe_yw_loy_target } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_yw_loy > var:oe_yw_loy_target }
        change_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_loy < var:oe_yw_loy_target } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_loy value = var:oe_yw_loy_target } }
    }
    oe_yw_tier_update = yes
}
# Yunnan / Liang (LNG) names: the Prince of Yunnan in 1337, Prince of Liang from 1355 (decision 183, design 6.5).
oe_yw_name_yunnan = {
    change_country_name = OE_YW_YUNNAN
    change_country_adjective = OE_YW_YUNNAN_ADJ
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_lng_name value = 1 }
}
oe_yw_name_liang = {
    change_country_name = OE_YW_LIANG
    change_country_adjective = LNG_ADJ
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_lng_name value = 2 }
}

# Any scope. The first run in a new 1337 game: the nine princes join (those that are CHI's subjects), the grant books
# open as paid for 1337, Liang is called Yunnan.
oe_yw_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yw_on
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yw_yuan_fallen = no }
        c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 1 w = 2 name = OE_YW_NAME_QAS } } }
        c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 2 w = 2 name = OE_YW_NAME_HCN } } }
        c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 3 w = 2 name = OE_YW_NAME_OTC } } }
        c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 4 w = 2 name = OE_YW_NAME_BGT } } }
        c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 5 w = 1 name = OE_YW_NAME_OGE } } }
        c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 6 w = 1 name = OE_YW_YUNNAN } } }
        c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 7 w = 0 name = OE_YW_NAME_SYG } } }
        c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 8 w = 1 name = OE_YW_NAME_YLU } } }
        c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 9 w = 1 name = OE_YW_NAME_YZW } } }
        c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_sub = yes } oe_yw_register = { n = 10 w = 1 name = OE_YW_NAME_YBN } } }
        c:CHI ?= {
            set_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_level value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_unit value = oe_yw_grant_unit_value }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_mult value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_total value = oe_yw_grant_total_value }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_y value = oe_yw_year }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_ok value = 1 }
        c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_prince } oe_yw_name_yunnan = yes } }
        oe_yw_sync_overlord_host = yes
    }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: the line starts (the Yuan princes)"
}

# Any scope, January. The annual grant (Yuan shi 95): unit x weight to each member (Shen none); the Yuan pays when it holds
# the total (twice the total if it is AI). Level 0, or not enough gold: each member with a weight lapses this year.
oe_yw_grant = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_unit value = oe_yw_grant_unit_value } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_mult value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { c:CHI = { var:oe_yw_grant_level ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_mult value = 2 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_y value = oe_yw_year }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_total value = oe_yw_grant_total_value }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_grant_total > 0 NOT = { c:CHI = { var:oe_yw_grant_level ?= 0 } } c:CHI = { gold >= oe_yw_grant_need } }
            c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } add_gold = oe_yw_share_value set_variable = { name = oe_yw_paid_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:CHI = {
                add_gold = { value = global_var:oe_yw_grant_total multiply = -1 }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_grant_mult = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_boost_y value = oe_yw_year } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_level value = 1 } }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_ok value = 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_yw: annual grant paid"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_grant_total > 0 }
            c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 oe_yw_fy_stopped = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_lapse_y value = oe_yw_year } } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_ok value = -1 }
            debug_log = "oe_yw: annual grant not paid (stopped, or not enough gold)"
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grant_ok value = 0 } }
    }
}

# Any scope, June. The Shangdu assembly: at Shangdu while the Yuan holds it, else at Dadu, else none (global var
# oe_yw_meet_place 1 / 2 / 0). Each AI member comes with oe_yw_att_chance; 4 or more: Yuan prestige +5.
oe_yw_assembly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_y value = oe_yw_year }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { owns = location:shangdu } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_place value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { owns = location:dadu } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_place value = 2 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_place value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yw_meet_place > 0 }
        c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes is_ai = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_att_chance set_variable = { name = oe_yw_att_y value = oe_yw_year } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_meet_n add = 1 } } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_meet_n >= 4 } c:CHI ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_kurultai_due = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_kurultai_pending value = 1 }
        }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: the assembly (place in oe_yw_meet_place, princes in oe_yw_meet_n)"
}

# Any scope, January. The modifiers of the members' tiers get 13 more months, and CHI's overlord host refreshes.
oe_yw_renew = {
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_tier } oe_yw_apply_tier = yes } }
    oe_yw_sync_overlord_host = yes
}

# Any scope, monthly. A registered prince that is no longer CHI's subject leaves (modifier off, oe_yw_out 2 independent,
# 3 another's subject, 4 released by vanilla red_turban_rebellions.42); one that is CHI's subject again comes back.
oe_yw_members = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:QAS } c:QAS = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_prince NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_out } oe_yw_sub = no }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged }
            if = { limit = { has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.42 capital ?= { region = region:manchuria_region } } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_out value = 4 } }
            else_if = { limit = { is_subject = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_out value = 2 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_out value = 3 } }
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal }
            debug_log = "oe_yw: QAS is no longer the Yuan's subject (oe_yw_out 2 independent, 3 another's subject, 4 released by vanilla .42)"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_prince has_variable = oe_yw_out NOT = { var:oe_yw_out ?= 5 } oe_yw_sub = yes oe_yw_yuan_fallen = no }
            remove_variable = oe_yw_out
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_tier } remove_variable = oe_yw_tier }
            if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia }
            debug_log = "oe_yw: QAS is the Yuan's subject again"
        }
    } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HCN } c:HCN = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_prince NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_out } oe_yw_sub = no }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged }
            if = { limit = { has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.42 capital ?= { region = region:manchuria_region } } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_out value = 4 } }

            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_out value = 3 } }

            debug_log = "oe_yw: HCN is no longer the Yuan's subject (oe_yw_out 2 independent, 3 another's subject, 4 released by vanilla .42)"

            if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia }

# Any scope, monthly. Records the moments the line waits for.
oe_yw_upkeep = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_d_bayan } oe_yw_bayan_in_power = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_d_bayan value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
        debug_log = "oe_yw: Bayan no longer holds power"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_d_yv6 } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { var:oe_yv_st_6 ?= 1 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_d_yv6 value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
        debug_log = "oe_yw: Y4's oe_yv.6 (Bayan grand chancellor) seen sent"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_d_kor } country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { NOT = { ruler ?= character:kor_chungsuk } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_d_kor value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
        debug_log = "oe_yw: Goryeo's king is no longer Chungsuk"
    }
    oe_yw_members = yes
}

# Any scope, monthly. Every member's loyalty step.
oe_yw_loyalty = {
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
    c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } oe_yw_loy_step = yes } }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the appanages (phase 3, M2; Yuan shi 95)
# Any scope, monthly. Each member with an appanage in the table (FIEF): country var oe_yw_fy_lost while no location of
# it is held by the Yuan or a Yuan subject. Held again: the choice of event .8 ends (oe_yw_fy off) and an event still
# queued is taken back (it may come later if the appanage is lost again; once sent it never comes again).
oe_yw_fief_update = {
    c:QAS ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: QAS's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
                remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_QAS ?= 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_QAS }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: QAS's appanage is held again"
            }
        }
    }
    c:HCN ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: HCN's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
                remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_HCN ?= 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_HCN }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: HCN's appanage is held again"
            }
        }
    }
    c:OTC ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: OTC's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
                remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_OTC ?= 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_OTC }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: OTC's appanage is held again"
            }
        }
    }
    c:BGT ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: BGT's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
                remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_BGT ?= 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_BGT }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: BGT's appanage is held again"
            }
        }
    }
    c:OGE ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: OGE's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
                remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_OGE ?= 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_OGE }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: OGE's appanage is held again"
            }
        }
    }
    c:LNG ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: LNG's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
                remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_LNG ?= 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_LNG }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: LNG's appanage is held again"
            }
        }
    }
    c:YLU ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: YLU's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }

            }
        }
    }
    c:YZW ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_yw_fief_held = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 } debug_log = "oe_yw: YZW's appanage is lost (loyalty -12)" }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
                remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_YZW ?= 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_YZW }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: YZW's appanage is held again"
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope, January (before the grant). A member whose appanage is lost and whose event never came is queued for .8
# (global oe_yw_fy_<TAG> = 1).
oe_yw_fief_year = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_QAS } country_exists = c:QAS c:QAS = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_QAS value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: QAS's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_HCN } country_exists = c:HCN c:HCN = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_HCN value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: HCN's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_OTC } country_exists = c:OTC c:OTC = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_OTC value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: OTC's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_BGT } country_exists = c:BGT c:BGT = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_BGT value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: BGT's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_OGE } country_exists = c:OGE c:OGE = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_OGE value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: OGE's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_LNG } country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_LNG value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: LNG's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_YLU } country_exists = c:YLU c:YLU = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_YLU value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: YLU's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_YZW } country_exists = c:YZW c:YZW = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_YZW value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: YZW's appanage lost, event oe_yw.8 queued" }
}
# Any scope, monthly after the schedule. Sends .8 for the first queued member: at most one event a month, none in a month in
# which a Yuan line (this one included) already sent the Yuan an event, none while an earlier .8 is unanswered (global
# oe_yw_fy_p; given up after 6 months).
oe_yw_fy_send = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_p has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_pm global_var:oe_yw_m > oe_yw_fy_stale }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_p
        debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.8 left unanswered, given up"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_p } oe_yw_yuan_busy = no country_exists = c:CHI }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_QAS ?= 1 country_exists = c:QAS c:QAS = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_QAS = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_HCN ?= 1 country_exists = c:HCN c:HCN = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_HCN = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_OTC ?= 1 country_exists = c:OTC c:OTC = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_OTC = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_BGT ?= 1 country_exists = c:BGT c:BGT = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_BGT = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_OGE ?= 1 country_exists = c:OGE c:OGE = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_OGE = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_LNG ?= 1 country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_LNG = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_YLU ?= 1 country_exists = c:YLU c:YLU = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_YLU = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_YZW ?= 1 country_exists = c:YZW c:YZW = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } } oe_yw_fy_fire_YZW = yes }
    }
}
# Event .8 for QAS (prince 1).
oe_yw_fy_fire_QAS = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_QAS value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_p value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_pm value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    oe_yw_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.8 (QAS's appanage lost) sent to CHI"
    c:CHI ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.8 }
}

# CHI scope (event .8 options, inside hidden_effect; no debug_log here: a player command reaches it). Usage:
# oe_yw_fy_set = { s = N }: the choice N for the prince of the event (global var oe_yw_fy_p), then the event is answered.
oe_yw_fy_set = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_p }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 1 } c:QAS ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 2 } c:HCN ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 3 } c:OTC ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 4 } c:BGT ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 5 } c:OGE ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 6 } c:LNG ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 8 } c:YLU ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_p = 9 } c:YZW ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy value = $s$ } } }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yw_fy_p
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- world steps (no popup; design 3.6)
# W1 (Shen, 1339): Shen's prestige -5 and its opinion of Goryeo (the pair of Y1's oe_y1_shen_faction).
oe_yw_do_w1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w1 value = 1 }
    c:SYG = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_shen_fail target = c:KOR } }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W1 the Shen faction's rising failed (Shen prestige -5, opinion of Goryeo)"
}
# W2 (1341, the Prince of Xuanrang's seal given back): the grievance ends; members +5 for 24 months.
oe_yw_do_w2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w2 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_grief value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_restore_until value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_restore_until add = 24 }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W2 the princes are reassured"
}
# W4 (1361): the Prince of Yangdi's rising is put down. Liberty desire -20, the event item cleared. Nobody is killed.
oe_yw_do_w4 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w4 value = 1 }
    c:OGE = { add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_severe_minus oe_yw_clear_ev = yes }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W4 the Prince of Yangdi's rising is put down"
}
# W5 (Xia in Yunnan, 1362-1364): Liang's stability -7, Liang and Dali like each other.
oe_yw_do_w5 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w5 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w5_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    c:LNG = { add_stability = stability_mild_penalty add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_aid target = c:CDL } }
    c:CDL = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_aid target = c:LNG } }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W5 Dali came to Liang's aid against Xia"
}
# W6 (some years later; phase 3: one account only, KBM 37 [14:56-18:04]): Liang and Dali fall out, by one account Liang
# has Duan Gong killed. The goodwill ends; Dali's opinion of Liang -30 for 60 months, liberty desire +10. W9 follows.
oe_yw_do_w6 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w6 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w6_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    c:LNG = { remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_aid target = c:CDL } }
    c:CDL = {
        remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_aid target = c:LNG }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_slain target = c:LNG }
        add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_plus
    }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W6 Liang and Dali fall out (one account: Duan Gong murdered)"
}
# W9 (phase 3; KBM 37 [18:04], [21:51]): reconciled through an official's mediation. The falling-out ends: Dali's ill
# opinion off, both like each other (15, 120 months), Dali's liberty desire -10.
oe_yw_do_w9 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w9 value = 1 }
    c:CDL = {
        remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_slain target = c:LNG }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_peace target = c:LNG }
        add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus
    }
    c:LNG = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_duan_peace target = c:CDL } }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W9 Liang and Dali reconciled"
}
# W8 (phase 3; KBM 20 [17:38], 30 [14:11]; Yuan shi 95 术赤大王位): the Golden Horde's envoy receives the revenue of the
# Jochid appanages (Pingyang, Jinzhou, Yongzhou). The Yuan pays oe_yw_glh_gold to the Golden Horde, whose opinion of the
# Yuan rises (20, 120 months). Both AI.
oe_yw_do_w8 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w8 value = 1 }
    c:CHI = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_tmp value = oe_yw_glh_gold } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp global_var:oe_yw_tmp > 0 }
        c:CHI = { add_gold = { value = global_var:oe_yw_tmp multiply = -1 } }
        c:GLH = { add_gold = global_var:oe_yw_tmp }
    }
    c:GLH = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_bw_glh_grant target = c:CHI } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W8 the Golden Horde's envoy received the Jochid appanage revenue"
}
# W7 (phase 2 + phase 4 M8 flavor; 1352, Yuan shi 42: the Prince of Bin rewarded for killing the leader of the Xifan rebels;
# house of Chübei four seats: Bin at Suzhou, Xining at Shazhou, Su at Guazhou, Weiwu Xining at Hami; Idiqut of Gaochang
# later submitted to Ming after the fall of Yuan): the prince's prestige +5, loyalty +5 now (no event item).
oe_yw_do_w7 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w7 value = 1 }
    c:YBN = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = 5 } }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W7 the Prince of Bin (Suzhou/Shazhou/Hami house of Chubei) put down the Xifan rising (prestige +5, loyalty +5)"
}
# W10 (phase 4, M3 Yunnan remainder; 1345-1385, cooldown 60m, max 3 times): a random tusi subject of LNG turns
# restive (oe_yw_tusi_unrest 60m + liberty desire), and LNG takes a minor stability hit. Runs both before and after Yuan falls.
oe_yw_do_w10 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w10_n } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w10_n value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w10_n add = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w10 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w10_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    c:LNG ?= {
        add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
        random_subject = {
            limit = { is_subject_type = tusi }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_tusi_unrest months = 60 mode = replace }
            add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_plus
        }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: W10 Yunnan tusi unrest (random tusi oe_yw_tusi_unrest 60m + liberty desire, Liang stability hit)"
}
oe_yw_w10_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m > 584 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w10 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w10 value = 2 }
        debug_log = "oe_yw: W10 (Yunnan tusi unrest) dropped"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            global_var:oe_yw_m >= 93
            global_var:oe_yw_m <= 584
            NOT = { global_var:oe_yw_w10_n ?= 3 }
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w10_m }
                global_var:oe_yw_m >= oe_yw_w10_next
            }
            oe_yw_ok_w10 = yes
        }
        random = { chance = 4 oe_yw_do_w10 = yes }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The world steps W1, W2, W4, W5, W6, W8, W9, W10 (W3 is in event .4's immediate; W7 with the Prince of Bin).
oe_yw_world = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_yw_m > 80 global_var:oe_yw_m > oe_yw_hi_w1 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w1 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W1 (the Shen faction) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m >= oe_yw_lo_w1 oe_yw_ok_w1 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_yw_wch_1 oe_yw_do_w1 = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w2 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_st_2 ?= 2 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w2 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W2 (the princes reassured) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_st_2 ?= 1 global_var:oe_yw_m >= oe_yw_lo_w2 }
            oe_yw_do_w2 = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w4 } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    global_var:oe_yw_m > 296
                    global_var:oe_yw_st_5 ?= 2
                    AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_yangdi NOT = { global_var:oe_yw_yangdi = 1 } }
                }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w4 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W4 (Yangdi put down) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m >= 290 oe_yw_ok_w4 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_yw_wch_4 oe_yw_do_w4 = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w5 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m > 332 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w5 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W5 (Dali's aid) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m >= 299 oe_yw_ok_w5 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_yw_wch_5 oe_yw_do_w5 = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w6 } }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_yw_w5 ?= 2 global_var:oe_yw_m > oe_yw_hi_w6 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w6 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W6 (the governor's death) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_w5 ?= 1 global_var:oe_yw_m >= oe_yw_lo_w6 oe_yw_ok_w6 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_yw_wch_6 oe_yw_do_w6 = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w7 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m > 189 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w7 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W7 (the Prince of Bin against the Xifan) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m >= 183 oe_yw_ok_w7 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_yw_wch_7 oe_yw_do_w7 = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w8 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m > 32 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w8 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W8 (the Golden Horde's appanage revenue) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m >= 21 oe_yw_ok_w8 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_yw_wch_8 oe_yw_do_w8 = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w9 } }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_yw_w6 ?= 2 global_var:oe_yw_m > oe_yw_hi_w9 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w9 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W9 (Liang and Dali reconciled) dropped"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_w6 ?= 1 global_var:oe_yw_m >= oe_yw_lo_w9 oe_yw_ok_w9 = yes }
            random = { chance = oe_yw_wch_9 oe_yw_do_w9 = yes }
        }
    }
    oe_yw_w10_step = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 4: M3 Yunnan remainder + M8 NW princes
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). Updates oe_yw_liang_cut_off on LNG depending on Hexi corridor (lanzhou, suzhou_gansu).
oe_yw_liang_cut_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:LNG }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m <= 644 c:LNG = { oe_yw_liang_stands = yes } oe_yw_hexi_cut_off = yes }
            c:LNG = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_liang_cut_off months = 13 mode = replace } }
        }
        else = {
            c:LNG = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_liang_cut_off } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_liang_cut_off } }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). On Yuan's fall: LNG keeps Northern Yuan calendar (oe_yw_liang_loyal until 1390) and checks Hexi.
# One-time notice oe_yw.9 if player is LNG or CHI (or old Yuan via oe_yp_yuan); AI logs silently.
oe_yw_do_liang_fall = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m3_liang } global_var:oe_yw_m <= 644 country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { oe_yw_liang_stands = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m3_liang value = 1 }
        c:LNG = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_liang_loyal months = oe_yw_months_to_1390 mode = replace } }
        oe_yw_liang_cut_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_9 } }
            if = {
                limit = { c:LNG = { is_ai = no } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_9 value = 1 }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                c:LNG = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.9 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { is_ai = no } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_9 value = 1 }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.9 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan global_var:oe_yp_yuan ?= { is_ai = no } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_9 value = 1 }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                global_var:oe_yp_yuan = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.9 }
            }
            else = { debug_log = "oe_yw: M3 Liang keeps the Northern Yuan calendar (AI, silent)" }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3; called from oe_yw.10 options inside hidden_effect -> NO debug_log here!).
# Applies opinion with the non-Mongol Middle Kingdom leader and records oe_yw_duan_choice (1 petition, 2 defiant).
oe_yw_duan_op_a = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_duan_choice value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yw_new_son_of_heaven = yes country_exists = c:CDL }
        international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country ?= {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_b_duan_petition target = c:CDL }
        }
        c:CDL = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_b_duan_petition target = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country }
        }
    }
}
oe_yw_duan_op_b = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_duan_choice value = 2 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yw_new_son_of_heaven = yes country_exists = c:CDL }
        international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country ?= {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_b_duan_defiant target = c:CDL }
        }
        c:CDL = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yw_b_duan_defiant target = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). AI Dali resolution of oe_yw.10 (75/25); no forced subject tie or land transfer.
oe_yw_do_duan_ai = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_10 value = 1 }
    random_list = {
        75 = {
            c:CDL ?= {
                add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_duan_petition months = 60 mode = replace }
            }
            oe_yw_duan_op_a = yes
            debug_log = "oe_yw: M3 AI Dali petitions by Tang and Song precedent"
        }
        25 = {
            c:CDL ?= {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_duan_defiant months = 60 mode = replace }
            }
            oe_yw_duan_op_b = yes
            debug_log = "oe_yw: M3 AI Dali holds Erhai defiantly"
        }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). Monthly post-fall check for Dali petition (1375-1390).
oe_yw_duan_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_10 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m > 644 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_10 value = 2 }
            debug_log = "oe_yw: M3 Dali petition event dropped (past 1390)"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yw_m >= 453 oe_yw_can_10 = yes }
            random = {
                chance = oe_yw_wch_duan
                if = {
                    limit = { c:CDL = { is_ai = no } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_10 value = 1 }
                    oe_yw_count = yes
                    debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.10 sent to player CDL"
                    c:CDL = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.10 }
                }
                else = { oe_yw_do_duan_ai = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M8). On Yuan's fall or Gansu lost: YBN falls back to Hami and Guasha (oe_yw_bin_westward 120m,
# oe_yw_bin_west = 1); one-time notice oe_yw.11 if player is YBN or CHI (or old Yuan via oe_yp_yuan); AI logs silently.
oe_yw_do_bin_west = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_bin_west } country_exists = c:YBN }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_bin_west value = 1 }
        c:YBN = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_bin_westward months = 120 mode = replace } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_11 } }
            if = {
                limit = { c:YBN = { is_ai = no } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_11 value = 1 }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                c:YBN = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.11 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { is_ai = no } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_11 value = 1 }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.11 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan global_var:oe_yp_yuan ?= { is_ai = no } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_11 value = 1 }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                global_var:oe_yp_yuan = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.11 }
            }
            else = { debug_log = "oe_yw: M8 Prince of Bin shifts westward to Guasha and Hami (AI, silent)" }
        }
    }
}
oe_yw_bin_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_bin_west } country_exists = c:YBN oe_yw_gansu_fallen = yes }
        oe_yw_do_bin_west = yes
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly after Yuan falls (while oe_yw_post_on is set, through 1390.12; hook for gen_mainline_lock.py LINES id 20).
oe_yw_post_monthly = {
    oe_yw_w10_step = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:LNG }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_yw_m > 644 c:LNG = { oe_yw_liang_stands = no } } }
            c:LNG = {
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_liang_loyal } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_liang_loyal }
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_liang_cut_off } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_liang_cut_off }
            }
        }
        else = { oe_yw_liang_cut_check = yes }
    }
    oe_yw_duan_step = yes
    oe_yw_bin_check = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yw_post_needed = no }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yw_post_on
        debug_log = "oe_yw: post-fall Yunnan/NW tail closed"
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the collapse (F6's COLLAPSE_HOOKS; also this line's own check)
# Any scope. Once: every tier modifier off, each prince's fate (country var oe_yw_fate and global var oe_yw_fate_<TAG>:
# 1 still the old Yuan's subject (the Northern Yuan), 2 independent, 3 another's subject, 4 gone), every pending event and
# world step (except W10) dropped, global var oe_yw_ended = reason, the line off; phase 4 triggers M3 Liang / M8 Bin
# westward reactions and opens oe_yw_post_on through 1390.12. No land, no subject tie, no war (decision 109 / 180).
oe_yw_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_ended } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_ended value = oe_yw_end_reason }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:QAS } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fate_QAS value = 4 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:QAS } c:QAS = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged }
            if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan is_subject_of = global_var:oe_yp_yuan } AND = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan } country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fate value = 1 } }
            else_if = { limit = { is_subject = no } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fate value = 2 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_yw_fate value = 3 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fate_QAS value = var:oe_yw_fate }
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal }
        } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:HCN } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fate_HCN value = 4 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HCN } c:HCN = {

        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w3 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w4 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w4 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w5 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w5 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w6 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w6 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w7 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w7 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w8 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w8 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w9 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w9 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_QAS ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_QAS value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_HCN ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_HCN value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_OTC ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_OTC value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_BGT ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_BGT value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_OGE ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_OGE value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_LNG ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_LNG value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_YLU ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_YLU value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_fy_YZW ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_YZW value = 3 } }
        c:CHI ?= {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_overlord_loyal_host } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_overlord_loyal_host }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_kurultai_tradition_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_kurultai_tradition_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_kurultai_commute_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_kurultai_commute_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_kurultai_hanlaw_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_kurultai_hanlaw_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_crisis_strict_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_crisis_strict_mod }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_on }
        oe_yw_do_liang_fall = yes
        oe_yw_do_bin_west = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_yw_post_needed = yes } set_global_variable = oe_yw_post_on }
        debug_log = "oe_yw: the Yuan fell; the princes' markers are off and their fates recorded (oe_yw_fate_<TAG>)"
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scheduler (Y4 / Y1 pattern; state in global vars)
oe_yw_fire_1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    oe_yw_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.1 sent to CHI"
    c:CHI ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.1 }
}

# Any scope. Drops events that can no longer fire.
oe_yw_ev_lapse = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_1 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.1 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_2 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.2 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_3 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.3 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_4 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.4 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_lapse_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_5 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.5 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_6 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.6 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_lapse_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_7 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yw: event oe_yw.7 dropped" }
}
# Any scope. Picks at most one event this month (none while another Yuan line has sent CHI an event this month): an event
# at its window end first, else one roll per open event.
oe_yw_ev_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yw_yuan_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { oe_yw_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yw_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yw_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yw_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yw_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yw_due_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yw_due_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 7 } }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 0 oe_yw_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_ch_1 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 1 } } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 0 oe_yw_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_ch_2 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 2 } } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 0 oe_yw_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_ch_3 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 3 } } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 0 oe_yw_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_ch_4 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 4 } } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 0 oe_yw_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_ch_5 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 5 } } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 0 oe_yw_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_ch_6 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 6 } } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 0 oe_yw_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yw_ch_7 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pick value = 7 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 1 } oe_yw_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 2 } oe_yw_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 3 } oe_yw_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 4 } oe_yw_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 5 } oe_yw_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 6 } oe_yw_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_pick = 7 } oe_yw_fire_7 = yes }
}

# BYZ scope (any scope works), monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 20 "yw") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_init } }. The first call decides once whether
# this is a new 1337 game. The events take no main-line lock (they never go to Byzantium).
oe_yw_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_init } }
        set_global_variable = oe_yw_init
        if = { limit = { current_date < 1337.6.1 } oe_yw_setup = yes }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_yw: not a new 1337 game, the line stays off" }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now }
        if = { limit = { oe_yw_yuan_fallen = yes } oe_yw_on_yuan_fall = yes }
        else = {
            oe_yw_upkeep = yes
            oe_yw_fief_update = yes
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_yw_fief_year = yes oe_yw_grant = yes oe_yw_renew = yes }
            if = { limit = { current_month = 6 } oe_yw_assembly = yes }
            oe_yw_loyalty = yes
            oe_yw_sync_overlord_host = yes
            oe_yw_world = yes
            oe_yw_bin_check = yes
            if = { limit = { oe_yw_sched_open = yes } oe_yw_ev_lapse = yes oe_yw_ev_pick = yes }
            oe_yw_fy_send = yes
            # v14.5 Princes 2.0: dispatch unified 10-year / new-ruler Shangdu Kurultai (oe_yw.20)
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_yw_kurultai_pending
                    oe_yw_yuan_busy = no
                    country_exists = c:CHI
                }
                remove_global_variable = oe_yw_kurultai_pending
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_kurultai_y value = oe_yw_year }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                c:CHI = {
                    ruler ?= { set_variable = oe_yw_kurultai_done }
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.20
                }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: unified Shangdu Kurultai oe_yw.20 sent to CHI"
            }
            # v14.5 Princes 2.0: low-shi crisis event oe_yw.21 when oe_y7_shi < 35 and any prince is estranged (<40)
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    oe_yw_yuan_busy = no
                    country_exists = c:CHI
                    has_global_variable = oe_y7_shi
                    global_var:oe_y7_shi < 35
                    oe_yw_any_estranged = yes
                    OR = {
                        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_crisis21_m }
                        global_var:oe_yw_m >= oe_yw_crisis21_next
                    }
                }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_crisis21_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
                oe_yw_count = yes
                c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.21 }
                debug_log = "oe_yw: low-shi crisis oe_yw.21 sent to CHI"
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_post_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now }
        oe_yw_post_monthly = yes
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- v14.5 Princes 2.0: interactive GUI & Kurultai / crisis helpers (CMDLOG=0)
# Location scope (CMDLOG=0). Age-appropriate Mongol light/heavy cavalry regiments owned by CHI.
oe_yw_spawn_lc = {
    if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = levee_en_masse_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_6_revolutions_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = military_revolution_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_5_absolutism_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = artillery_institution_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_4_reformation_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = pike_and_shot_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_3_discovery_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = professional_armies_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_2_renaissance_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
}
oe_yw_spawn_hc = {
    if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = levee_en_masse_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_6_revolutions_heavy_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = military_revolution_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_5_absolutism_heavy_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = artillery_institution_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_4_reformation_heavy_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = pike_and_shot_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_3_discovery_heavy_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = professional_armies_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_2_renaissance_heavy_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
    else = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_heavy_cavalry owner = c:CHI } }
}
# CHI scope + scope:target_country = active prince (CMDLOG=0). GUI button 1: 赐金印 (Bestow Imperial Gold Seal).
oe_yw_gui_bestow_seal_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            tag = CHI
            exists = scope:target_country
            scope:target_country = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_cd_seal } }
            gold >= 35
        }
        add_gold = -35
        add_prestige = -5
        scope:target_country = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_yw_cd_seal years = 3 }
            oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = 15 }
            add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_yw_bw_bestow_seal }
            add_liberty_desire = -10
        }
    }
}
# CHI scope + scope:target_country = active prince (CMDLOG=0). GUI button 2: 虎符勤王 (Summon Princely Banner Cavalry).
oe_yw_gui_summon_banner_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            tag = CHI
            exists = scope:target_country
            scope:target_country = {
                oe_yw_prince_active = yes
                has_variable = oe_yw_loy
                var:oe_yw_loy >= 65
                manpower >= 0.8
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_cd_banner }
            }
            gold >= 40
        }
        add_gold = -40
        scope:target_country = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_yw_cd_banner years = 5 }
            add_manpower = -0.8
            oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -4 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { location:dadu = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } }
            location:dadu = { oe_yw_spawn_lc = yes oe_yw_spawn_hc = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { exists = capital capital = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } }
            capital = { oe_yw_spawn_lc = yes oe_yw_spawn_hc = yes }
        }
    }
}
# CHI scope + scope:target_country = active prince (CMDLOG=0). GUI button 3: 折钞改土 (Commute & Provincialize Touxia cleanly).
oe_yw_gui_commute_prov_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            tag = CHI
            exists = scope:target_country
            scope:target_country = {
                oe_yw_prince_active = yes
                has_variable = oe_yw_loy
                var:oe_yw_loy >= 75
            }
            OR = {
                is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_yuan_restoration
                has_global_variable = oe_sit2_yr_ended
                current_year >= 1400
            }
        }
        scope:target_country = {
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_prince } remove_variable = oe_yw_prince }
            set_variable = { name = oe_yw_out value = 5 }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged } remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_commuted_vassal_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
        }
        add_prestige = 5
        add_legitimacy = 5
        oe_yw_sync_overlord_host = yes
    }
}
# CHI scope (CMDLOG=0). Kurultai oe_yw.20 Option A helper: lower liberty desire of all active princes.
oe_yw_kurultai_opt_a = {
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
    c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus } }
}
