# ---------------------------------------------------------------- worker jobs (hidden event oe_yw.29, CHI scope)
# Event .2 option b: the sum in global var oe_yw_pot goes to the members by grant weight (Shen none).
oe_yw_job_console = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_wsum_now value = oe_yw_wsum }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_pot global_var:oe_yw_wsum_now > 0 }
        c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
        c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes var:oe_yw_w > 0 } add_gold = oe_yw_pot_share } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_pot } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_pot }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yw_wsum_now
}
# Event .4 option a: Yunnan becomes Liang again; an AI Liang gains prestige.
oe_yw_job_liang = {
    c:LNG ?= {
        oe_yw_name_liang = yes
        if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: the Prince of Yunnan is raised to Prince of Liang"
}
# Event .7 option a (phase 2): the sum the Yuan paid goes to the Prince of Bin (the gift of notes of 1353); an AI prince still in
# the line sends a tenth of its manpower to the Yuan (written as oe_yw_ask_aid's manpower).
oe_yw_job_shazhou = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_pot value = oe_yw_cost_1m }
    c:YBN ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_pot } add_gold = global_var:oe_yw_pot }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = yes oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_tmp value = oe_yw_shazhou_mp_value }
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp global_var:oe_yw_tmp > 0 }
                add_manpower = { value = global_var:oe_yw_tmp multiply = -1 }
                c:CHI ?= { add_manpower = global_var:oe_yw_tmp }
            }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_tmp }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_pot } remove_global_variable = oe_yw_pot }
    debug_log = "oe_yw: the Shazhou troops go to Sichuan (the sum to the Prince of Bin; a tenth of an AI prince's manpower to the Yuan)"
}

# The line runs from now in any game: the princes join again, every event pending (windows already past lapse at once).
oe_yw_test_start = {
    oe_yw_test_clear = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_yw_init
    oe_yw_setup = yes
}
# One month of the line now (starts it first in a game where it never started).
oe_yw_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_init } } set_global_variable = oe_yw_init oe_yw_setup = yes }
    oe_yw_monthly = yes
}
# Sends one event now (its own trigger still applies; the console 'event oe_yw.N' ignores it).
oe_yw_test_fire_1 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } } oe_yw_fire_1 = yes }
oe_yw_test_fire_2 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } } oe_yw_fire_2 = yes }

# World step W7 now (phase 2; the Prince of Bin must be a member; ignores the window and the AI condition).
oe_yw_test_w7 = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YBN c:YBN = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } oe_yw_do_w7 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: W7 not run, the Prince of Bin is not a member" }
}

# Switches the line off and clears it (the next scheduler round finds it initialised and leaves it off).
oe_yw_test_reset = {
    oe_yw_test_clear = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_yw_init
    debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: line reset and off"
}
# ---- phase 3 tests (page 48)
# Probe: every member that is the Yuan's vassal becomes a 投下宗王 now; and back.
oe_yw_test_touxia = {
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } if = { limit = { is_subject_type = vassal country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_yw_touxia } } }
    debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: members switched to the 投下宗王 type (see ty<N> in oe_yw.90)"
}
oe_yw_test_vassal = {
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:HCN ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:OTC ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:BGT ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:OGE ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:LNG ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:SYG ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:YLU ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:YZW ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    c:YBN ?= { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia } change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal } }
    debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: the princes switched back to vassals"
}
# The Prince of Qi's appanage counts as lost (no land moves), then the January check queues event .8; and back.
oe_yw_test_fief_lose = {
    c:QAS ?= { set_variable = oe_yw_fy_test }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
    oe_yw_fief_update = yes
    oe_yw_fief_year = yes
}
oe_yw_test_fief_back = {
    c:QAS ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_test } remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_test } }
    oe_yw_fief_update = yes
}
# Sends event .8 for the Prince of Qi to the current player's country (its trigger wants the Yuan: tag CHI first).
oe_yw_test_fire_8 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_p value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_fy_pm value = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.8
}
# World steps W6, W8, W9 now (they ignore the window and the AI condition; the countries must exist).
oe_yw_test_w6 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LNG country_exists = c:CDL c:CDL = { is_subject_of = c:LNG } } oe_yw_do_w6 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: W6 not run (Liang or Dali gone, or Dali not Liang's subject)" }
}
oe_yw_test_w9 = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LNG country_exists = c:CDL c:CDL = { is_subject_of = c:LNG } } oe_yw_do_w9 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: W9 not run (Liang or Dali gone, or Dali not Liang's subject)" }
}
oe_yw_test_w8 = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI country_exists = c:GLH } oe_yw_do_w8 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: W8 not run (the Yuan or the Golden Horde gone)" }
}
# ---- phase 4 tests (page 48: ywmw10, ywm9, ywm10, ywmbin)
oe_yw_test_w10 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = tusi } } } oe_yw_do_w10 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: W10 not run (Liang gone or has no tusi subject)" }
}
oe_yw_test_m9 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:LNG }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m3_liang value = 1 }
        c:LNG = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_liang_loyal months = oe_yw_months_to_1390 mode = replace } }
        oe_yw_liang_cut_check = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_9 value = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.9
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: M3 .9 not run (Liang gone)" }
}
oe_yw_test_m10 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
    if = {
        limit = { tag = CDL country_exists = c:CDL }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_10 value = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.10
    }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CDL } oe_yw_do_duan_ai = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: M3 .10 not run (Dali gone)" }
}
oe_yw_test_bin = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_m value = oe_yw_m_now } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:YBN }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_bin_west value = 1 }
        c:YBN = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yw_bin_westward months = 120 mode = replace } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_st_11 value = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.11
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yw TEST: M8 .11 not run (Prince of Bin gone)" }
}
